crosswalks.label: Digital Forensics Analysts
crosswalks.rationale: O*NET 31.0 directly covers preservation, analysis and presentation of computer-related digital evidence.

crosswalks.label: Cybercrime Investigation
crosswalks.rationale: NICE v2.1+ comprehensively revised Cybercrime Investigation task/knowledge/skill alignments; legal/investigative authority remains separate from AXM technical forensics.

findings.summary: Digital Forensics must preserve evidence identity and reproducibility while keeping technical observation separate from legal admissibility, attribution and incident-command authority.
findings.rationale: Research-backed boundary is compiled into package-local machinery.

gaps_against_body.description: Make source-versus-derived evidence, custody integrity and observation-versus-attribution boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Digital Forensics Specialist reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No technical access, package construction, role label, model capability or repository permission creates legal, security, safety, privacy, risk, product or institutional authority.
